reader.requirement: In sequential access the I-O statement executed on this file just before a REWRITE must be a successful READ (otherwise I-O status 43, nothing replaced), and the REWRITE replaces the record that READ accessed; I-O statements on OTHER files do not count.

reader.edition-search: the 43 gate is FileConnector's Status setter (drops it on every outcome) and ReadSucceeded (re-arms it); neither consults the edition (grep 'Edition|DialectBehavior' in FileConnector.cs: only Edition, SharingFacilityInEffect and the '61' arm at 1297).

reader.notes: The gate is per connector and dropped at the one Status setter, so every statement on the file (START, failed REWRITE, unsuccessful READ) clears it, and only ReadSucceeded re-arms it. Rewrite tests it first, ahead of the 44 and 21 checks, in the rules' order.
